manual.text: Read the course's generative-AI policy; decide and record whether and how AI assistance may be used for the article, instructions and video, and add any declaration it requires
Confirm the deadline, the article template, page and word limits, the video length and the file names with the lecturer, then set article_max_pages
Give markers access to the repository (it may be private) or attach a source archive and the release assets to the submission
Upload the article, GROUP05_INSTRUCTIONS.pdf and the video link to the course system
Write the individual contribution statements, if the course asks for them
Watch the final video and check every frame for tokens, credentials, user names and home paths before upload
